entries.text: Notice Regarding Deficient Motion to Appear Pro Hac Vice

ORDER: Accordingly, it is hereby ORDERED that, on or before September 2, 2026, Plaintiff shall amend its Complaint to sufficiently allege Panni Holdings's principal place of business. If, by that date, Plaintiff is unable to amend the Complai nt to truthfully allege complete diversity of citizenship, then the Complaint will be dismissed for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction without further notice to either party. ( Amended Pleadings due by 9/2/2026.) (Signed by Judge Jesse M. Furman on 8/26/2026) (rro) Order AND ~Util - Set Deadlines/Hearings
